Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Julius Randle?

Julius Randle is 31 years old.

Where was Julius Randle born?

Julius Randle was born in Dallas, Texas.

When was Julius Randle born?

Julius Randle was born on November 29, 1994.

How tall is Julius Randle?

Julius Randle is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

How much does Julius Randle weigh?

Julius Randle weighs 250 lbs (113 kg).

Is Julius Randle in the Hall of Fame?

Julius Randle is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Julius Randle drafted?

Julius Randle was drafted by Los Angeles Lakers, 1st round (7th pick, 7th overall), 2014 NBA Draft.

What position does Julius Randle play?

Power Forward and Center.

What is Julius Randle's net worth?

Julius Randle has made at least $194,811,960 playing professional basketball.

How much does Julius Randle make?

Julius Randle made $33,073,920 in 2025.

How many rings does Julius Randle have?

Julius Randle has won 0 championships.

What is Julius Randle's Instagram account?

Julius Randle is on Instagram at juliusrandle30.

What schools did Julius Randle attend?

Julius Randle attended Prestonwood Christian in Plano, Texas and Kentucky.

What are Julius Randle's nicknames?

Beyblade, Orange Julius, Don Julio, Big Ju, King Julius, Black Panther, The Sergeant, Goosebumps are nicknames for Julius Randle.
